project: Mario Strikers Charged native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Plays a VS match at about 60 fps, no graphics errors seen. Tested on Windows 11 and on the Linux mini PC by playing into the first real scene (mini PC: a VS match, 59.5 fps with the disc on an SSD, still a few hitches (5 frames over 34 ms in 57 s, the longest 103 ms); from a hard disk more, as the game reads the disc during play). Nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
